s0201.literal: On xinyou day an edict instructed Chen Rijun of Annam to come to court in person.
s0201.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict instructed Chen Rijun of Annam to come to court in person.

s0202.literal: Liang Ceng, vice pacification commissioner of the Hunan Route, was selected and appointed minister of personnel, wearing a three-pearl tiger tally; Chen Fu, compiler in the Hanlin Imperial History Institute, was appointed bureau director in the Ministry of Rites, wearing a gold tally; together they were sent as envoys to Annam.
s0202.idiomatic: Liang Ceng, vice pacification commissioner of the Hunan Route, was selected and appointed minister of personnel with a three-pearl tiger tally; Chen Fu, compiler in the Hanlin Imperial History Institute, was appointed bureau director in the Ministry of Rites with a gold tally; together they were sent as envoys to Annam.

s0203.literal: The surveillance commission of Shandong East and West Circuit impeached: "Pacification commissioner Le Shi embezzled 120 ingots from the treasury, purchased 950 taels of treasury silver, had the official workshop privately manufacture saddles, bridles, and other items, and accepted 180 ingots from garrison-farm lands; Le Shi ought to be dismissed from office.
s0203.idiomatic: The surveillance commission of Shandong East and West Circuit impeached, "Pacification commissioner Le Shi embezzled 120 ingots from the treasury, purchased 950 taels of treasury silver, had the official workshop privately manufacture saddles, bridles, and other items, and accepted 180 ingots from garrison-farm lands; Le Shi ought to be dismissed from office."

s0205.literal: On dingmao day central secretariat officials said: "Among the newly submitted cave barbarians of Maoxian, Shiwei, Anhua, and elsewhere there are 80,000 in all; a military-civilian control office should be established, with the native headmen Meng Yi, Meng Shi, and Mo Zhongwen as chief officers and Lü Tianyou and Tabudai as darughachis.
s0205.idiomatic: On dingmao day central secretariat officials said, "Among the newly submitted cave barbarians of Maoxian, Shiwei, Anhua, and elsewhere there are 80,000 in all; a military-civilian control office should be established, with the native headmen Meng Yi, Meng Shi, and Mo Zhongwen as chief officers and Lü Tianyou and Tabudai as darughachis.

s0206.literal: The Eight Banners Uighurs have brought over the Guanglanzhou cave barbarians; Dingyuan Prefecture should be established, and those they recommend—Tugan, Gao Shouwen, Huang Shiceng, and Yanzige—should serve as darughachi, prefect, vice prefect, and assistant prefect.
s0206.idiomatic: The Eight Banners Uighurs have brought over the Guanglanzhou cave barbarians; Dingyuan Prefecture should be established, and those they recommend—Tugan, Gao Shouwen, Huang Shiceng, and Yanzige—should serve as darughachi, prefect, vice prefect, and assistant prefect.

s0208.literal: On guiyou day Qianzhou's seat was moved to Duoshui County; Xinde Prefecture was abolished and Tongjiang County established; Mianzhu County in Hanzhou was restored.
s0208.idiomatic: On guiyou day Qianzhou's seat was moved to Duoshui County; Xinde Prefecture was abolished and Tongjiang County established; Mianzhu County in Hanzhou was restored.

s0209.literal: People of Shazhou and Guazhou were resettled in Ganzhou; an edict ordered land to be marked out for cultivation on the border between Gan and Su; those without means were granted cattle, implements, and farm tools.
s0209.idiomatic: People of Shazhou and Guazhou were resettled in Ganzhou; an edict ordered land marked out for cultivation on the border between Gan and Su, and those without means were granted cattle, implements, and farm tools.

s0210.literal: Ningxia had a large population, yet half its fields grew safflower; an edict ordered that all land be planted with grain and wheat to supplement the people's food.
s0210.idiomatic: Ningxia had a large population, yet half its fields grew safflower; an edict ordered all land planted with grain and wheat to supplement the people's food.

s0211.literal: On dingchou day, because Pingluan Route had suffered both great flood and frost, 24,041 shi of field rent was remitted.
s0211.idiomatic: On dingchou day, because Pingluan Route had suffered both great flood and frost, 24,041 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0212.literal: On xinsi day Venus transgressed Southern Dipper.
s0212.idiomatic: On xinsi day Venus transgressed Southern Dipper.

s0213.literal: The Yunnan branch censorate was abolished and relocated to Xichuan; a Yunnan surveillance commission was established.
s0213.idiomatic: The Yunnan branch censorate was abolished and relocated to Xichuan; a Yunnan surveillance commission was established.

s0214.literal: On renwu day Shuodada and Jurchen households driven out from rebel territories were escorted back to their original places and assigned among wanhu, qianhu, and baihu units for garrison farming.
s0214.idiomatic: On renwu day Shuodada and Jurchen households driven out from rebel territories were escorted back to their original places and assigned among wanhu, qianhu, and baihu units for garrison farming.

s0215.literal: On jiashen day the U-Tsang pacification commission said: "Since Byirigong's rebellion the post stations have been cut off and the people are too poor to supply transport duties.
s0215.idiomatic: On jiashen day the U-Tsang pacification commission said, "Since Byirigong's rebellion the post stations have been cut off and the people are too poor to supply transport duties."

s0216.literal: An order granted U-Tsang's five stations 100 horses, 200 cattle, and 500 sheep each, all paid in silver;
s0216.idiomatic: An order granted U-Tsang's five stations 100 horses, 200 cattle, and 500 sheep each, all paid in silver;

s0217.literal: and 736 military households 155 ingots of silver each.
s0217.idiomatic: and 736 military households 155 ingots of silver each.

s0218.literal: On dinghai day, at the Xuanzheng Bureau's request, a branch pacification commission and overall commander were established for the three circuits of U-Tsang, Nari, and Sugursun.
s0218.idiomatic: On dinghai day, at the Xuanzheng Bureau's request, a branch pacification commission and overall commander were established for the three circuits of U-Tsang, Nari, and Sugursun.

s0219.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the wuzi new moon, Zhang Shidao, investigative officer of the Fujian surveillance commission, was summoned to court;
s0219.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on the wuzi new moon, Zhang Shidao, investigative officer of the Fujian surveillance commission, was summoned to court;

s0220.literal: Zhang Shidao arrived and requested trimming redundant posts in inner and outer government offices.
s0220.idiomatic: Zhang Shidao arrived and requested trimming redundant posts in inner and outer government offices.

s0221.literal: Maishuding, He Rongzu, Ma Shao, Yan Gongnan, and others were ordered together with Shidao to sort them out.
s0221.idiomatic: Maishuding, He Rongzu, Ma Shao, Yan Gongnan, and others were ordered together with Shidao to sort them out.

s0222.literal: Several months later Shidao was appointed Hanlin direct academician.
s0222.idiomatic: Several months later Shidao was appointed Hanlin direct academician.

s0223.literal: Japanese ships arrived at Siming seeking mutual trade; armor and weapons were all aboard and there was fear of hostile intent; an edict established a commander-in-chief headquarters and ordered Haladai to lead it to guard the sea route.
s0223.idiomatic: Japanese ships arrived at Siming seeking mutual trade; armor and weapons were all aboard and there was fear of hostile intent; an edict established a commander-in-chief headquarters and ordered Haladai to lead it to guard the sea route.

s0224.literal: An edict ordered dredging of Zhexi river channels to direct water to the sea.
s0224.idiomatic: An edict ordered dredging of Zhexi river channels to direct water to the sea.

s0225.literal: On gengyin day Lianghuai transport commissioner Nasurding was implicated for accepting merchants' bribes and issuing extra salt; when the matter came to light an edict ordered strict interrogation.
s0225.idiomatic: On gengyin day Lianghuai transport commissioner Nasurding was implicated for accepting merchants' bribes and issuing extra salt; when the matter came to light an edict ordered strict interrogation.

s0226.literal: On guisi day the wine prohibition in Shangdu was lifted.
s0226.idiomatic: On guisi day the wine prohibition in Shangdu was lifted.

s0227.literal: Yan Gongnan said: "At year's end each provincial minister comes to court to report affairs; branch censorate officials should also come to court to report the year's impeachments.
s0227.idiomatic: Yan Gongnan said, "At year's end each provincial minister comes to court to report affairs; branch censorate officials should also come to court to report the year's impeachments."

s0229.literal: On bingshen day the Sichuan branch secretariat presented seven cave-barbarian chiefs including Xiang Sicong at court.
s0229.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Sichuan branch secretariat presented seven cave-barbarian chiefs including Xiang Sicong at court.

s0230.literal: On renyin day, at Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan's request, Gao Decheng was appointed commander of the ten-thousand-household naval office, wearing a double-pearl tiger tally; Yin Shi and Tao Daming were again appointed as deputies and ordered to lead the expedition sailors.
s0230.idiomatic: On renyin day, at Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan's request, Gao Decheng was appointed commander of the ten-thousand-household naval office with a double-pearl tiger tally; Yin Shi and Tao Daming were again appointed as deputies and ordered to lead the expedition sailors.

s0231.literal: On jiachen day envoys from the Xiegenateyin state came for an audience.
s0231.idiomatic: On jiachen day envoys from the Xiegenateyin state came for an audience.

s0232.literal: The Guangdong Route pacification commission sent men to carry to the capital the golden book presented by the king of Siam.
s0232.idiomatic: The Guangdong Route pacification commission sent men to carry to the capital the golden book presented by the king of Siam.

s0233.literal: On yisi day the moon transgressed Well.
s0233.idiomatic: On yisi day the moon transgressed Well.

s0234.literal: On dingwei day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0234.idiomatic: On dingwei day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0235.literal: On jiyou day Privy Council officials said: "Among the Six Guards' Chinese-army wanhu units, 6,000 households remain; they should be divided into three groups: 2,500 households strong enough to supply horses and carts, each squad ordered to provide 15 horses and 2 ox-carts;
s0235.idiomatic: On jiyou day Privy Council officials said, "Among the Six Guards' Chinese-army wanhu units, 6,000 households remain; they should be divided into three groups: 2,500 households strong enough to supply horses and carts, each squad ordered to provide 15 horses and 2 ox-carts;

s0236.literal: 500 households strong enough to supply carts, each squad ordered to provide 3 ox-carts;
s0236.idiomatic: 500 households strong enough to supply carts, each squad ordered to provide 3 ox-carts;

s0237.literal: the other 3,000 households shall only train for combat and not be given other corvées.
s0237.idiomatic: the other 3,000 households shall only train for combat and not be given other corvées.

s0238.literal: Those beyond the 6,000 shall supply other corvées.
s0238.idiomatic: Those beyond the 6,000 shall supply other corvées.

s0239.literal: Thus each may attend diligently to his duty and the troops will also be elite.
s0239.idiomatic: Thus each may attend diligently to his duty and the troops will also be elite.

s0241.literal: An edict ordered lighter-sentenced prisoners selected and released.
s0241.idiomatic: An edict ordered lighter-sentenced prisoners selected and released.

s0242.literal: On guichou day Wanze and others said: "Whenever gifts to various persons amount to 200,000 ingots, the number being so large, those first granted receive everything, and when later grants come there may be nothing left to give—the inequality is extreme.
s0242.idiomatic: On guichou day Wanze and others said, "Whenever gifts to various persons amount to 200,000 ingots, the number being so large, those first granted receive everything, and when later grants come there may be nothing left to give—the inequality is extreme.

s0243.literal: Now calculate kesig, kelyan, shibochi, and halaqi—altogether the close attendants: the upper grade at a rate of 200 households, the middle half that, the lower again half; among the lower grade choose the poorest for added annual grants, and the imbalance will be removed.
s0243.idiomatic: Now calculate kesig, kelyan, shibochi, and halaqi—altogether the close attendants: the upper grade at a rate of 200 households, the middle half that, the lower again half; among the lower grade choose the poorest for added annual grants, and the imbalance will be removed.

s0244.literal: Revenue for the year totals 2,978,305 ingots; this year only 1,893,993 ingots have been collected; of these some have not yet reached the capital and are en route, and some have already been issued to armies, textile workshops, post stations, and salaries—from spring until now 3,638,543 ingots have been spent; expenditure already exceeds revenue by 660,238 ingots.
s0244.idiomatic: Revenue for the year totals 2,978,305 ingots; this year only 1,893,993 ingots have been collected; of these some have not yet reached the capital and are en route, and some have already been issued to armies, textile workshops, post stations, and salaries—from spring until now 3,638,543 ingots have been spent; expenditure already exceeds revenue by 660,238 ingots.

s0245.literal: The Huaimeng bamboo tax yields 1,093 ingots yearly; the ministry secretariat apportions it among the people and they truly suffer—it should be abolished.
s0245.idiomatic: The Huaimeng bamboo tax yields 1,093 ingots yearly; the ministry secretariat apportions it among the people and they truly suffer—it should be abolished.

s0246.literal: " The Emperor praised and adopted all their remarks.
s0246.idiomatic: The Emperor praised and adopted all their remarks.

s0247.literal: Zhao Deze and Wu Rong were ordered to lead 240 unowned fugitive-slave households to pan silver and farm fields in Guangning and Shenzhou.
s0247.idiomatic: Zhao Deze and Wu Rong were ordered to lead 240 unowned fugitive-slave households to pan silver and farm fields in Guangning and Shenzhou.

s0248.literal: On yimao day the moon transgressed Root.
s0248.idiomatic: On yimao day the moon transgressed Root.

s0249.literal: Eleventh month, gengshen day: Huarong County in Yuezhou flooded; 2,125 shi of grain was issued to relieve the hungry.
s0249.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengshen day: Huarong County in Yuezhou flooded; 2,125 shi of grain was issued to relieve the hungry.

s0250.literal: On renxu day the moon transgressed Encampment.
s0250.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transgressed Encampment.

s0251.literal: On wuyin day the Privy Council memorialized: "One guard of ten thousand men customarily assigns 2,000 to garrison farming; Mubalshah's Shangdu garrison farm succeeded after two years; it is proposed to add 1,000 troops.
s0251.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Privy Council memorialized, "One guard of ten thousand men customarily assigns 2,000 to garrison farming; Mubalshah's Shangdu garrison farm succeeded after two years; it is proposed to add 1,000 troops."

s0253.literal: On jimao day the moon transgressed the upper chancellor of the eastern rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0253.idiomatic: On jimao day the moon transgressed the upper chancellor of the eastern rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0254.literal: On guiwei day private ferry crossings were forbidden everywhere and frontier passes ordered to inspect for criminals.
s0254.idiomatic: On guiwei day private ferry crossings were forbidden everywhere and frontier passes ordered to inspect for criminals.

s0255.literal: On bingxu day six cave chiefs including Yang Xiuchao of Tisheng, Jinzhou, and Tongren submitted at court and presented local products.
s0255.idiomatic: On bingxu day six cave chiefs including Yang Xiuchao of Tisheng, Jinzhou, and Tongren submitted at court and presented local products.

s0256.literal: Twelfth month, gengyin day, central secretariat officials said: "The imperial grandson, Prince of Jin Gammala, once governed Yunnan and was given the Prince of Liang seal; now enfeoffed as Prince of Jin, he should be given the Prince of Jin seal.
s0256.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengyin day, central secretariat officials said, "The imperial grandson, Prince of Jin Gammala, once governed Yunnan and was given the Prince of Liang seal; now enfeoffed as Prince of Jin, he should be given the Prince of Jin seal.

s0257.literal: The commandant Yeligudai and marshal Huangwu of the Prince of Beian's household were both made marshals of the Prince of Jin; Buqidadai and Di Cong were also appointed marshals.
s0257.idiomatic: The commandant Yeligudai and marshal Huangwu of the Prince of Beian's household were both made marshals of the Prince of Jin; Buqidadai and Di Cong were also appointed marshals.

s0258.literal: Jinchi lay directly on the route of Mangwu Tu'ermishi's expeditionary troops and horses; to supply their fodder and grain it was made Mulai Prefecture.
s0258.idiomatic: Jinchi lay directly on the route of Mangwu Tu'ermishi's expeditionary troops and horses; to supply their fodder and grain it was made Mulai Prefecture.

s0259.literal: " An edict ordered Yingchang Prefecture to grant Qidadai 500 shi of grain to relieve famine victims.
s0259.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yingchang Prefecture to grant Qidadai 500 shi of grain to relieve famine victims.

s0260.literal: On guisi day central secretariat officials said: "Six hundred households in Ningguo Route mine silver from the hills; the annual quota is 2,400 taels—all bought on the market to pay the government, never actually mined from the hills; we ask that it be abolished.
s0260.idiomatic: On guisi day central secretariat officials said, "Six hundred households in Ningguo Route mine silver from the hills; the annual quota is 2,400 taels—all bought on the market to pay the government, never actually mined from the hills; we ask that it be abolished."

s0262.literal: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Well.
s0262.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Well.

s0263.literal: On jiachen day the moon transgressed the western rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0263.idiomatic: On jiachen day the moon transgressed the western rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0264.literal: On jiyou day Abu, son of Asan, former darughachi of the chief civilian-military superintendent of Luichuan Route, together with Zhao Sheng and others, brought in Huluma of Jinchi in Muhulu, whose son Aru came to court and presented local products.
s0264.idiomatic: On jiyou day Abu, son of Asan, former darughachi of the chief civilian-military superintendent of Luichuan Route, together with Zhao Sheng and others, brought in Huluma of Jinchi in Muhulu, whose son Aru came to court and presented local products.

s0265.literal: Aru said that on their southeastern border about 200,000 people not yet submitted admired civilization and wished to submit; he requested an edict ordering Abu and Zhao Sheng to instruct them; this was approved.
s0265.idiomatic: Aru said that on their southeastern border about 200,000 people not yet submitted admired civilization and wished to submit; he requested an edict ordering Abu and Zhao Sheng to instruct them; this was approved.

s0266.literal: On renzi day the central secretariat was ordered to follow U-Tsang post-station precedent in granting Heli and Hubi stations horses, cattle, and sheep, 9,500 taels of silver in all.
s0266.idiomatic: On renzi day the central secretariat was ordered to follow U-Tsang post-station precedent in granting Heli and Hubi stations horses, cattle, and sheep, 9,500 taels of silver in all.

s0267.literal: On dingsi day the Directorate of Waterways was ordered to repair the Shatang River dikes and weirs in Baoding Prefecture.
s0267.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Directorate of Waterways was ordered to repair the Shatang River dikes and weirs in Baoding Prefecture.

s0268.literal: That year 466,713 ingots of notes were granted to imperial sons, grandsons, princes, kinsmen, palace guards, and frontier soldiers.
s0268.idiomatic: That year 466,713 ingots of notes were granted to imperial sons, grandsons, princes, kinsmen, palace guards, and frontier soldiers.

s0269.literal: 5,523 shi of scattered-rations grain were issued to soldiers; 368,428 ingots of notes relieved those in need.
s0269.idiomatic: 5,523 shi of scattered-rations grain were issued to soldiers; 368,428 ingots of notes relieved those in need.

s0270.literal: Seventy-two Buddhist services were ordered performed by the state preceptor, monks, and mantra masters.
s0270.idiomatic: Seventy-two Buddhist services were ordered performed by the state preceptor, monks, and mantra masters.

s0272.literal: Thirtieth year, spring, first month, renxu day: envoys were dispatched by edict to summon and instruct the Qitou and Jinchi barbarians.
s0272.idiomatic: Thirtieth year, spring, first month, renxu day: envoys were dispatched by edict to summon and instruct the Qitou and Jinchi barbarians.

s0273.literal: On yichou day Fujian was ordered not to present gyrfalcons.
s0273.idiomatic: On yichou day Fujian was ordered not to present gyrfalcons.

s0274.literal: On wuxu day four hundred Chinese troops from Karakorum were retained at one hundred and the rest ordered to garrison-farm at Hanghai.
s0274.idiomatic: On wuxu day 400 Chinese troops from Karakorum were retained at 100 and the rest ordered to garrison-farm at Hanghai.

s0275.literal: On bingyin day the moon transgressed Net.
s0275.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon transgressed Net.

s0276.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to trim redundant posts: 255 offices inner and outer in all, totaling 669 posts.
s0276.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to trim redundant posts: 255 offices inner and outer in all, totaling 669 posts.

s0277.literal: On dingmao day the Prince of Anxi requested that attendants-in-ordinary be established as before; this was not approved.
s0277.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Prince of Anxi requested that attendants-in-ordinary be established as before; this was not approved.

s0278.literal: The Yunnan Yanqing Office was abolished; the two barbarian chiefs Luobo and Bu'er were remotely appointed prefects, each granted a sealed edict.
s0278.idiomatic: The Yunnan Yanqing Office was abolished; the two barbarian chiefs Luobo and Bu'er were remotely appointed prefects, each granted a sealed edict.

s0279.literal: On wuchen day Privy Council officials memorialized: "The Uqunqa division's Umulughan army is supplied each year with 6,426 shi of transported grain, costing 12,852 ingots in hire wages.
s0279.idiomatic: On wuchen day Privy Council officials memorialized, "The Uqunqa division's Umulughan army is supplied each year with 6,426 shi of transported grain, costing 12,852 ingots in hire wages."

s0280.literal: " An edict said that since the frontier was peaceful, that army should garrison-farm for its own food.
s0280.idiomatic: An edict said that since the frontier was peaceful, that army should garrison-farm for its own food.

s0281.literal: On gengwu day cave chiefs including Yang Zongguo came to court.
s0281.idiomatic: On gengwu day cave chiefs including Yang Zongguo came to court.

s0282.literal: Two hundred Niekilie Jurchen who supported themselves by fishing received an order: "Rather than fish in the water, how much better to work the fields—grant them cattle prices and farm tools and have them farm.
s0282.idiomatic: Two hundred Niekilie Jurchen who supported themselves by fishing received an order, "Rather than fish in the water, how much better to work the fields—grant them cattle prices and farm tools and have them farm."

s0283.literal: On jiaxu day Bayan, Pingzhang of the Henan-Jiangbei branch secretariat, said: "The garrison farms established by Mangwu Tai in Yangzhou cover more than 40,000 qing; beyond what the government sows, the people should be allowed to cultivate; the Yangzhou salt transport office has a triple layer of agencies—the salt office should be cut and only the supervisor retained.
s0283.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Bayan, Pingzhang of the Henan-Jiangbei branch secretariat, said, "The garrison farms established by Mangwu Tai in Yangzhou cover more than 40,000 qing; beyond what the government sows, the people should be allowed to cultivate; the Yangzhou salt transport office has a triple layer of agencies—the salt office should be cut and only the supervisor retained.

s0284.literal: Xiangyang formerly consumed Jingzhao salt; weighing land and water transport difficulties, it would be better to switch to Yangzhou salt.
s0284.idiomatic: Xiangyang formerly consumed Jingzhao salt; weighing land and water transport difficulties, it would be better to switch to Yangzhou salt.

s0285.literal: Caizhou is far from Bianliang; it should be promoted from a scattered prefecture, with Ying, Xi, Xinyang, and Guangzhou placed under it.
s0285.idiomatic: Caizhou is far from Bianliang; it should be promoted from a scattered prefecture, with Ying, Xi, Xinyang, and Guangzhou placed under it.

s0286.literal: " An edict approved all his proposals.
s0286.idiomatic: An edict approved all his proposals.

s0287.literal: Guangzhou was promoted to upper-route chief prefecture; the fish-salt bureau established by Nasurding and Mi'erli was abolished; Xingguo Route in Jiangxi was transferred to Huguang branch secretariat.
s0287.idiomatic: Guangzhou was promoted to upper-route chief prefecture; the fish-salt bureau established by Nasurding and Mi'erli was abolished; Xingguo Route in Jiangxi was transferred to Huguang branch secretariat.

s0288.literal: On yihai day the crown prince was posthumously titled Mingxiao.
s0288.idiomatic: On yihai day the crown prince was posthumously titled Mingxiao.

s0289.literal: On bingzi day three chiefs of Xifan Yidian barbarians came for an audience; each was granted a barbarian military-civilian office, and Zhang Daoming, who had summoned them, was made darughachi.
s0289.idiomatic: On bingzi day three chiefs of Xifan Yidian barbarians came for an audience; each was granted a barbarian military-civilian office, and Zhang Daoming, who had summoned them, was made darughachi.

s0290.literal: On dingchou day the moon transgressed Root.
s0290.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon transgressed Root.

s0291.literal: On wuyin day an edict ordered four hundred Jurchen households formerly under Nayan and Senggedai'er, who consumed rations idly, to garrison-farm at Yangzhou.
s0291.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict ordered 400 Jurchen households formerly under Nayan and Senggedai'er, who consumed rations idly, to garrison-farm at Yangzhou.

s0292.literal: On gengchen day Jupiter transgressed Left Law.
s0292.idiomatic: On gengchen day Jupiter transgressed Left Law.

s0293.literal: Seven post stations were established at Hao and Yizhou.
s0293.idiomatic: Seven post stations were established at Hao and Yizhou.

s0294.idiomatic: On xinsi day 28 stations were established from Qingyun to Helibin on the Liaoyang Route; each station was granted 30 oxen and 7 carts.

s0295.idiomatic: On renwu day Huai-West Route pacification commissioner Angir collected 600 ingots of army funds, 450 taels of silver, and 2 horses; the branch secretariat, censorate, and jarghuchi were ordered to investigate.

s0296.idiomatic: On dinghai day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Eastern Sea, and Earth Goddess on the Emperor's behalf.

s0297.idiomatic: Second month, jichou day, at Alawading and Yan Gongnan's request, Yang Lianzhenjia's son Anpu, Xuanzheng Bureau commissioner, was made left associate of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat.

s0298.idiomatic: An edict said, "Those who manage granaries at Shangdu have no rank or salary and therefore commit theft and fraud; officials of ranks 6b and 7b should be assigned and paid salaries.

s0299.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo requested that his name be changed to Ju; his deliberation office requested promotion to a deliberation bureau and a rank-2b seal; this was approved.

s0300.literal: Henan and Jiang-Zhe sea-transport grain was reduced by 400,000 shi.
s0300.idiomatic: Henan and Jiang-Zhe sea-transport grain was reduced by 400,000 shi.
